limits: Complete RN50 matrix on three small datasets, not the full research matrix. Frozen-head checks reproduce native saved test probabilities/metrics and initial heads. Original head refits change only the head; proximal sparse-head experiments remain separate. Nine head-refit intervals are descriptive, unadjusted and conditional on a fixed bank, selected generators/heads and one MC8 realization. Initial random-conditioning control retains its documented initialization/geometry confounds; do not infer pure semantic causality.
